verdicts.reason: RETIRED READING, KEPT VISIBLE. This archive carried the household as «Francesco COSSI & Maria Falco» from 1823 to 1828 and then corrected it to CIOFFI: the 1825 register, read at full resolution, writes the strada Camellara family with a DOTTED «i» after the C — «Cesare Cioffi», «Francesco Cioffi» — and writes the strada Cossi family, in the same volume and the same hand, without one. FRANCESCO CIOFFI is the father. «Francesco Cossi» is the same man under the discarded spelling, left standing because corrections in this archive are shown, not swapped. Re-confirmed 15 September 2026 on the 1824 birth act at four times magnification, after this reader had re-made the old mistake that morning.

DISPROVED BY DATES. Gaetana Laudato was «di anni SETTANTOTTO» when she died on 9 March 1816, so born about 1738, and she stands in this household as the WIDOW OF SIMONE MORGILLO — a generation above its head. Vincenzo Morgillo was twenty-nine in May 1828, so born about 1799. She was sixty-one at his birth. She is the house's elder, not his mother, and the graph read the role «mother» as a relationship to every child recorded in the same house.

DISPROVED — A DIFFERENT VINCENZO MORGILLO. The register names Giuseppe Morgillo «as a parent of Vincenzo Morgillo, FOUR DAYS OLD, strada Salvatorella», who died on 25 January 1816 (Arienzo death register 1816, image 6). The Vincenzo Morgillo of this record was twenty-nine in May 1828, a contadino of STRADA CAPPUCCINI and husband of Felicetta Rivetti, who declared two deaths at the Capuchin monastery in 1823 and 1826. An infant dead at four days in 1816 is not a man of twenty-nine in 1828, and the streets differ. Merged on the forename alone.

ONE WOMAN, TWO SPELLINGS, DELIBERATELY NOT MERGED. The family tree writes her «Giovanna Arricole»; the registers write her «Giovanna Arricale». The 1873 birth extract of her son Raffaele spells her «GIOVANNA ARRICALE FU FRANCESCO», which is the reading this archive follows. This archive does not merge two records on a matching name — that judgement belongs to whoever next reads an act that settles the spelling, and until then both records stand and the chart can say which is which.

RETIRED — THE TREE IS DESCRIBING A DIFFERENT CARMINA FALCO. This Carmina is documented by a single act: she died on 19 December 1832 «di mesi SEI» — at six months old — «figlia di FRANCESCO FALCO, contadino, e di RAFFAELA FALCO», on strada Camellara. Her father is FRANCESCANTONIO FALCO, identified from the 1832 marriage index. An infant who lived six months has no descendants, so the Carmina the family tree carries, with different parents, is another woman of the name; the two records were joined on the forename. The tree's parents are kept on the record rather than deleted, so that a reader who finds them there can see they were examined.
